description: Security alerts, advisories, and directives are not received, tracked, or disseminated on an ongoing basis.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing processes to receive security alerts from sources like US-CERT, vendor security bulletins, absence of internal alert distribution mechanisms, and lack of documented response procedures to security advisories.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - System and Information Integrity
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
